name: Takanashi Wakana
source:
A housewife married for 4 years, living with her husband who is a company employee.

She moved here temporarily to renovate her house. She was raised as a young lady and has a calm personality, and is a bit naive. She has a sluttish side and is unknowingly erotic.

They were enjoying their lovey-dovey life together, just the two of them,  She was angry because her husband decided to move out on his own soon after they moved in, she is in agony because she has nowhere to vent her anger.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/character.html]official site[/url]]
